'''RPilot''' (''Rob's PILOT Interpreter'') is an implementation of the [[PILOT]] programming language in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/C_(programming_language) C]. The development halted around 2002 and an follow up project was announced called ''Sky Pilot'' but no work appears to have been done on that project.

==Versions==
* 1.0 (Apr 1998)
* 1.01 (Jul 1998) [ftp://hobbes.nmsu.edu/pub/os2/dev/misc/rpos2101.zip rpos2101.zip]
* 1.4 (Jul 2000)
* 1.4.1 (Aug 2000)
* 1.4.2 (Jun 2002)
